description: This file defines interfaces for adapting stream event data to queue messages within Orleans streaming infrastructure. It includes methods for converting stream events into queue messages and vice versa, supporting batch processing.

classes.name: IQueueDataAdapter<TQueueMessage>
classes.description: Interface for converting stream event data to queue messages.

classes.name: IQueueDataAdapter<TQueueMessage, TMessageBatch>
classes.description: Interface extending IQueueDataAdapter, supporting conversion both to and from queue messages, including batch creation.

methods.name: ToQueueMessage
methods.description: Converts stream event data into a queue message of type TQueueMessage.

methods.name: FromQueueMessage
methods.description: Creates a message batch of type TMessageBatch from a queue message.
